qc/runs/kittle-2026-10-09-r2/raw-evidence-index.json (sha256 cc029e11...; scripted golden only, no configured judge run)
evidence: Nearly every negative leg is paired with a matching success: render gate pairs 'incorrect password is rejected'/'nothing private before sign-in' with Gwen opening her matters (gates/render/judge.toml:28-30); signin_and_client_scope Part B has an explicit positive control (functional/judge.toml:47); wall_every_route uses Sian's thread+search positive control (line 58) and Dev's list must show M-11/M-13 (59); wall_mentions_and_links pairs Dev's not-available with Harriet's working preview/link and the JUDGE-M2 mention (72-74); wall_added_live step 4 restores M-13 incl. JUDGE-WL0 (87); deleted_and_expired pairs empty searches with 'Clause 14 noted'/'JUDGE-X1' found and the 7-day boundary with the one-second-younger positive (112-118); timer_changes pairs empty searches with 'executor' found and the transcript containing it (131); hold_scope step 1 is an explicit delete positive (145); edits, safe_formatting (175 positive controls), message_links, unread (count 2 then cleared), sent_once (212 positive control), live_updates and search_and_transcript ('notice received and filed' found, 238) are paired. prompt.md:43-44 adds a global rule that every refusal pairs with a same-kind success in the same or an earlier criterion. Polish refusal_in_place pairs the wrong-password reason with a correct sign-in; visual likert 0-anchors are absence-scored by design. GAP: persistence item 3 (functional/judge.toml:262) is an absent-only search leg after restart: 'Searching as Harriet finds nothing for "Persist gone", "Probate", "Insurer letter", "Boundary note" or "Temp JUDGE-P2"'. Its only companion, '"Survey booked for Friday." appears exactly once in M-11', is a thread check (the scripted golden confirms this reading: functional.cjs:510 asserts search(...) == [] and :511 counts Survey via GET /api/matters/M-11, not search). No criterion runs a successful search after restart_app (persistence is last, prompt.md:59), so post-restart search is never positively verified, and an empty/broken search index passes item 3 by absence of evidence. The earlier-criterion search positives were before the restart, i.e. not 'while that target was eligible' in the same process state. Not exercised by any configured judge run (raw-evidence-index scope says none exists).
counterexample: App keeps its search index in memory (rebuilt only on seed import) and implements timer/hold-release purges as read-time filters that are not persisted while user deletes are persisted. After restart_app: item 1 passes (JUDGE-S2 user-delete persisted, S0/S1/hold/edit persisted), item 2 passes, item 3 searches all return nothing because the index is empty, and Survey appears once in the M-11 thread because seed was not re-imported. The criterion passes (weight 2.0) although search is broken after restart and the purged 'Probate estimate is 4,200 pounds.' has reappeared in the M-13 thread, which item 3 checks only via search. Conversely nothing misgrades a conforming app here, so the defect is a false-pass, not a false-fail.
suggested_fix: In persistence item 3 add a same-session search positive control, e.g. 'and searching "Persist child JUDGE-S1" finds exactly that message in M-11 (positive control that search still works after the restart)', and optionally require that the M-13 thread does not show 'Probate estimate'.
